description: Creates one printable math worksheet: five tasks, a brain teaser and a wide task, with the full answer key and a link that opens the same sheet as two A4 pages for printing. addition, subtraction and plus-minus take range 20, 100 or 1000; place-value takes range 100, 1000 or 1000000; times and division take table 2–10 or 'mixed'; written, quantities, word-problems and geometry take one of the foci listed in the focus parameter. With a grade and no range, table or focus, the sheet of that grade is chosen; a note in the result says when a sheet is printed for another grade. The same seed always gives the same sheet; without a seed the numbers are new.

focus.description: Focus for written, quantities, word-problems and geometry.

grade.description: School grade 1–4 the user asked for. Chooses the matching range when none is given; the printed grade still follows the content.

language.description: Language of the sheet: de (German school notation), en (US school notation), fr or es.

range.description: Number range for addition, subtraction, plus-minus (20, 100, 1000) and place-value (100, 1000, 1000000).

seed.description: Optional number 1–999999 that reproduces a sheet; without it the sheet gets new numbers.

table.description: Times table 2–10 or 'mixed', for times and division.

name: create_worksheet
title: Create a math worksheet
